name: Adam Baraz
reason: Too thin and mainly therapy: his only own site is Samadhi Bodywork in Berkeley (somatic bodywork and counselling sold on stress, anxiety and trauma release, with Somatic Experiencing trauma-therapy training), SomaWaken has no website (somawaken.com redirects to an unrelated dance temple, adambaraz.com is parked), no YouTube channel or books of his own (the YouTube Adam Baraz is a Hungarian composer), and his one Esalen programme (Embodying Joy, 15 to 17 Jan 2027, now full) is co-led with his father James Baraz and is already an offering on james-baraz.json.
